column1: # The protocol's signal numbers as the pinned gdbserver sends them: each of signals 1 to 31 raised once in a static
# program, under gdbserver --once with the pinned gdb attached (`handle all stop print`, so no signal passes the stub
# unreported), then continue and kill; the stop reply after the resume and the line gdb printed. Measured
#   the program raising the signal: sha256 2600be1928c986f5a428256ddd986fb61b8d15c42b1aa2147aa35834e1307026
# sniff-server maps a host number to the protocol's through this file only. SIGKILL (9) cannot stop: the process
# ends (gdbserver: X9;process:PID). SIGKILL and SIGSTOP are each held by a row of their own, not by this table.
